title: Free Recall of Word Lists with Repeated Items
description: This dataset contains behavioral events and intracranial electrophysiological recordings from a free recall task with repeated word items, collected across multiple clinical sites in collaboration with the Computational Memory Lab at the University of Pennsylvania. Participants studied lists of words presented visually, with items repeated at varying frequencies, and then freely recalled the words after a delay period. The dataset supports investigation of memory encoding and retrieval processes as a function of item repetition.
methods_description: Participants viewed lists of 27 words (drawn from 12 unique items repeated 1, 2, or 3 times) presented visually one at a time, followed by a 7-second delay and then a free recall period. Intracranial EEG recordings were collected using monopolar and bipolar referencing schemes, with electrode locations documented via MNI and Talairach coordinates. Data were recorded using Blackrock (250 nV units) and Medtronic (0.1 uV units) systems, scaled to volts.
